description: This file contains serialization and copying logic for nullable value types in the Orleans framework, including NullableCodec and NullableCopier classes.

classes.name: NullableCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for nullable value types, handling null and non-null values during serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: NullableCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for nullable value types, supporting shallow and deep copy operations.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a nullable value, writing null reference if value is null, otherwise serializing the actual value.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a nullable value, returning null if wire type indicates a null reference, otherwise reading the value.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidReference
methods.description: Throws exception if an invalid reference is encountered during deserialization.

methods.name: NullableCopier
methods.description: Constructor initializing the copier, possibly as an optional copier.

methods.name: IsShallowCopyable
methods.description: Indicates whether the copier supports shallow copying.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs deep copying of nullable values, using the underlying copier if available.
